localChanges: You can now play on an isometric map drawn with art imported from your own copy of Civilization II: import its TERRAIN1.GIF, TERRAIN2.GIF, UNITS.GIF and CITIES.GIF in Import assets, then choose the isometric grid when starting a game (#97, #152).
Import assets and Options say whether Civilization II's map art is complete and which of its files are still to import, and Import assets names a file it couldn't read (#97).
Loading an isometric save before Civilization II's art is imported says to import it first (#97).
